content: Now let me update the root layout and create the dashboard page:

args.Description: Root layout with dark mode by default (class='dark' on html), Inter font, TooltipProvider wrapper, and the sidebar + header shell composing the full app layout.

Dashboard page with stats overview, 6-step workflow visualization, and a call-to-action card. Stats show zeros initially (will be wired to Supabase in Phase 1). Rich visual design with gradient accents and hover states.
